in_marathi.name: Ruthvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of wealth and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ruthvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ruthvika is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'Goddess of wealth and prosperity'. It is a popular Hindu name and is believed to bring good fortune and abundance to the bearer. In Hindu mythology, the goddess of wealth and prosperity is often depicted as having a golden lotus in her hand, representing the abundance of wealth and prosperity she bestows upon her devotees.

vedic_reference.note: Ruthvika's name is derived from the Sanskrit word रुध् (rudh) which means to heal or cure. The suffix विकाम् (vikama) means the removal of pain or suffering. Thus, Ruthvika's name signifies the one who heals from pain or suffering.
